evidence.quote: Owned intelligence is not the same as rented intelligence.

observations.why: Flat unhedged assertion stated as a defensible distinction, but nothing in the text performs settling or ratification — argued-for position, not bedrock.

evidence.quote: the perspective is the asset you keep

observations.why: Constitutive values language — 'the asset you keep' frames the perspective as identity-level, permanent, creed-like; the substrate is dismissed as commodity, the perspective elevated to bedrock.
Explicitly self-labeled as a restatement for navigational scaffolding — the conviction is in service of positioning, not freshly performed; meta-level, easily moved.
